origin.description: Anderson-Darling test of the composite hypothesis of normality.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector with more than 7 non-missing values. Missing values are dropped.

origin.details: The statistic is A = -n - mean(h), where h weights the log of the normal cdf of the standardized order statistics. The p-value uses Stephens' table on A times (1 + 0.75/n + 2.25/n^2). The normal cdf on the log scale is pnorm(z, log.p = TRUE).
origin.value: An htest list with statistic A, the p-value, the method, and the data name.

translation.description: Anderson-Darling test of the composite hypothesis of normality.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric values with more than 7 non-missing entries. NaN is dropped.

translation.details: The statistic is A = -n - mean(h), where h weights the log of the normal cdf of the standardized order statistics. The p-value uses Stephens' table on A times (1 + 0.75/n + 2.25/n^2). The log cdf is SciPy log_ndtr. log(erf) is not accurate enough in the tail.
translation.value: An htest object with statistic A, the p-value, the method, and the data name.
translation.example:
from nortest import ad_test

x = [2.1, 3.4, float("nan"), 1.2, 5.6, 4.0, 3.3, 2.8, 6.1, 1.9, float("nan"), 4.4]
print(ad_test(x), end="")
